videos.desc: In a Pixar-style street court a tall girl in a yellow jersey dribbles between two defenders, drives to the hoop, leaps and dunks the ball, then hangs on the rim as everyone hugs and celebrates.
videos.said: Hey! No way! Woohoo! Oh God! That was good!

videos.desc: In a packed football stadium a fan with a painted face and rainbow scarf screams with joy, and the camera pulls back over the stands. Every single person in the huge crowd is on their feet cheering with raised arms at the same moment.

Young people play barefoot football on a beach at sunset. A woman in a green shirt dribbles past defenders in the sand and shoots at a goal by the water; the keeper dives and shouts 'No way!' as the ball flies past. She drops to her knees celebrating and her friends pile on her in a hug.
Friends play a pickup basketball game on an outdoor court at sunset; a red-haired woman dribbles past defenders, the ball drops through the hoop and her team hugs and cheers.

Friends carry a white goal frame onto a cobblestone town square and set it up; a young man dribbles and kicks the ball past the diving keeper into the goal, and the players jump and celebrate while two old men watch from a bench.
An animated girl at an indoor pool straps blue swim goggles over her eyes, gives a thumbs up to her coach, then dives in and swims underwater wearing them.
videos.said: Strap on! Nice and tight! Now I can see! Ha! Two big circles!

videos.desc: A girl at a skatepark shows a red helmet to the camera, puts it on and clicks the chin strap, then tries a skateboard, tumbles onto a blue crash mat and sits up smiling, tapping the helmet to show she is fine.
A blond man in a gray lion-print shirt walks up a concrete tunnel and stairs and comes out inside a huge stadium packed with fans in red, then stands looking out over the green football pitch.
A 3D-animated girl in a baseball uniform swings her bat at home plate, hits the ball high into the sunset sky and sprints toward first base while the crowd watches.

At an indoor rink a girl in a maroon jersey number 9 skates the puck around an orange cone, exchanges passes with a teammate and shoots past the goalie; the two players hug against the boards while fans cheer behind the glass.
A young woman laces up white ice skates on a frozen lake, then glides off and does a spraying stop, laughing with a friend nearby.

A young woman in wellies pushes a line-marking machine across a grass sports field, painting fresh white paint onto the grass. A drone shot then shows the long straight white line she has drawn across the whole pitch.

On a paved plaza in a colorful mountain town, players in teal shirts play street football against a defender; the man passes the ball to his teammate, she takes it, shoots at the small goal and the two celebrate with a hug.

An animated group of friends plays volleyball in a sunny park: a man dives for the ball and loses his hat, a woman leaps to spike over the net, and the mixed teams end up laughing and hugging on the grass.

Under floodlights at night, a football player in a yellow kit dribbles past a defender in blue, fires the ball into the goal, then slides on his knees screaming with joy as teammates pile on top of him.

At a village tug-of-war a man and a woman strain backwards pulling a thick rope until the red marker crosses the chalk line. They win, collapse on the grass laughing, and the onlookers applaud while a dog runs over.

On a tennis court a young woman in pink holds a black racket up to the camera, peers through the strings, spins and flips it in her hand, bounces a ball on the strings and then hits a forehand over the net, smiling.

A young woman buckles on purple rollerblades in a park full of fallen jacaranda petals, skates along the path toward the camera, crouches into a fast glide and stops with a petal spray beside a man on a bench, grabbing his drink.

On a sunny mountain slope above a fjord, a rider in a turquoise suit straps both boots onto an orange snowboard, rides off carving down the piste, and stops with a playful spray of snow next to a friend sitting on the slope.
videos.said: Just this. All good. No way!

videos.desc: On a tropical beach a woman rubs wax onto her long white surfboard, carries it into the sea, paddles out lying on it, pops up to ride a small wave, and hugs the board laughing in the shallows.

In a Ghibli-style anime scene, a rowing crew in matching teal shirts pulls their oars in perfect unison across a misty lake at sunrise, the small coxswain shouting the rhythm. They cross the finish, raise their oars together and lift her up in celebration.
videos.said: Together and hold! All six now! Yeah! Yeah! That was all of us!

videos.desc: A woman in tennis whites serves and rallies against an opponent on an orange clay court lined with cypress trees, sprinting between shots, diving full length for a ball and ending on her knees catching it as onlookers applaud.

Footballers run an evening training session on a floodlit pitch: one dribbles a ball through orange cones while the coach shouts "again!", the squad hops through an agility ladder in bibs, does sit-up drills, and finally collapses on their backs laughing.

A basketball player in a sports wheelchair speeds across an indoor court, dribbling beside his wheels. He rolls to the hoop, shoots and scores, then fist-pumps and celebrates with a teammate in another wheelchair.

A strip of green artificial putting turf is laid across the carpet of a living room. In the foreground a pink golf ball sits on a wooden tee stuck into a red toy brick. At the far end a man in a purple t-shirt lines up with a golf club, swings it and hits a ball down the strip. He immediately throws both arms straight up, jumps and runs off to the side while a friend sitting on the floor cheers with him.

A football pitch of bright green grass with white markings, laid impossibly high in the air with nothing but sky and a distant lake and forest far below its edges. A young woman in a dark football shirt, black shorts and long socks stands over a white and blue ball on the centre spot. She runs up and strikes the round ball towards the goal at the far end, where the keeper dives across. Then she keeps running, straight on across the pitch to where the green grass simply stops, spreads her arms out wide and leaps off the edge, and the shot follows her turning over and over as she falls through empty blue sky.

On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.

A point-of-view shot down a quiet suburban street lined with parked cars and clipped hedges under a blue sky full of white clouds. The camera holder's ringed hands push a yellow and blue volleyball up out of frame; a person in white clothes standing further down the road sets it back, and the ball drops into the waiting hands again.

In a pale living room a big brown dog sits bolt upright on the sofa like a person, front paws resting on a small black and white football, head turned to a wall-mounted television showing a live football match. A man in checked pyjama trousers lies stretched out on the sofa behind it, half watching. A low table in front holds white roses in a vase and two mugs.

A young archer stands on an open grass steppe drawing a recurve bow back to her cheek with one eye squeezed shut in concentration; the shot cuts down the range to three round black-and-white bullseye targets standing in the grass with green hills behind them, then back to her holding her aim while teammates in tracksuits watch from behind.

Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.

A skier in a red one-piece suit and helmet carves down a wide groomed piste in bright sun, throwing up a spray of snow on every turn. The camera follows from the side; behind him are snow-covered alpine peaks, a chairlift line and dozens of other skiers spread across the slope.

Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.

In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

In a school sports hall with basketball hoops, high windows and coloured lines on the floor, a young woman coach in a beige T-shirt, her hair in a ponytail, smooths a striped captain's armband onto the upper arm of a young woman player with cornrows in a blue shirt and black shorts, who beams with pride. The coach then puts her hands on the player's shoulder and arm. Behind them teammates in sports kit clap and cheer, and kit bags and a cardboard box sit by the wall.

On a rainy night under bright stadium floodlights, a player in a mud-smeared white uniform and a dark red helmet leaps along the white sideline and catches the brown football with both gloved hands while an opponent in gold reaches around him from behind. He tucks the ball in and runs on out of view, and an opponent rushes past. The view then shows coaches in dark jackets and teammates in white uniforms on the sideline, with a blue water cooler and the stands behind.

At a baseball game in a thunderstorm at night, a young woman in a muddy pinstriped uniform slides head first through a brown puddle and reaches for home plate, a white five-sided slab lying in the mud. Mud splashes around her as she lands on the plate, and she lifts her head and screams with joy. A catcher in a helmet reaches out with a glove, and an umpire in navy spreads his arms wide behind them. Floodlights shine through the rain, lightning flashes, and a crowd fills the stand.

A pit stop at a motor race under a cloudy sky. A young woman in a black and teal team suit and helmet kneels by the front wheel of a racing car, pressing a wheel gun onto it as sparks and smoke fly. Next to her another crew member holds an old tyre, a mechanic holds up a round stop sign, and wheel nuts lie scattered on the asphalt. When she is done she raises one arm high. Team members lean over the pit wall above, shouting and pointing.

A football game on a park pitch on a sunny autumn day, seen from beside the goal. A goalkeeper's orange gloves are raised in the foreground while the white ball flies far to the side of the goalpost, well away from the goal. The young man in a red shirt who kicked it holds his head, throws out his arms, then covers his face. A teammate in white falls back onto the grass, a spaniel runs along the white line, and fallen leaves, tall trees and brick flats surround the pitch.
